items.what: planning cycle 1
m1.t1: Initialize workspace: package.json, tsconfig.json, .gitignore, install dependencies (typescript, tsx, node-telegram-bot-api types, axios, node-cache)
m1.t2: Create src/ directory structure: index.ts, bot.ts, sessionStore.ts, salonSearch.ts, messageFormatter.ts, types.ts
m2.t1: Write src/types.ts: Session, Salon, ServiceType, BudgetLevel, BotState types
m2.t2: Port src/sessionStore.ts from WhatsApp sessionStore.js — in-memory Map with TTL, typed with Session interface
m2.t3: Port src/salonSearch.ts from WhatsApp salonSearch.js — resolveLocation (Nominatim), searchOSM (Overpass), searchGoogle (Places fallback), rankSalons, findSalons
skill extraction: m2.t3
m2.t4: Port src/messageFormatter.ts from WhatsApp messageFormatter.js — adapt to HTML parse mode (Telegram), add inline keyboard builders for service/budget/results/navigation
m3.t1: Write src/bot.ts — Telegram message handler: port WhatsApp state machine, handle text messages + location messages + /start + /help commands
m3.t2: Write src/bot.ts callback query handler — handle service selection, budget selection, result selection, back/new-search navigation via callback_data
skill extraction: m3.t2
m3.t3: Write src/index.ts — entry point: load .env (TG_BOT_TOKEN), create TelegramBot in polling mode, wire message + callback_query handlers, graceful shutdown
m4.t3: Git commit all source files, update journal.md with completion notes, update board.json task statuses to done
QA verification cycle 1
m5.t1: Create landing page: workspace/public/index.html — SEO, Open Graph, CTA button linking to bot, service list, how-it-works section
skill extraction: m5.t1
m5.t3: Add Overpass retry with exponential backoff in salonSearch.ts: 2 retries on HTTP 429/504 with 2s/4s delays; improves reliability on transient API failures
m5.t4: Improve messageFormatter.ts: add /cancel confirmation text, improve /help with /share command mention, improve /share copy
skill extraction: m5.t4
m5.t5: Write workspace/README.md as marketing copy: features, how to run, screenshots (text-described), Overpass/Google Places attribution, bot link
m5.t6: Run tsc --noEmit, fix any type errors, git commit all m5 changes, update journal.md + spending.json
